collection.title: Volvo XC70 2007 to 2016 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Volvo XC70 2007 - 2016 model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this XC70 which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
